mappings.answerReason: If the polygon has n sides, its angle sum is n(100+140)/2=120n. It is also 180(n-2), so 120n=180n-360 and n=6.

mappings.rationale: A common remainder forces the divisor to divide the pairwise differences. Use their greatest common divisor and the remainder bounds to determine the result.
mappings.answerReason: The divisor d divides 1417-1059=358 and 2312-1417=895. Their greatest common divisor is 179, which is prime, so d>1 forces d=179. Since 1059=5·179+164, r=164 and d-r=15.
